10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple Clik Valve products listed with prices: 11,99 €, 3,79 €, 9,99 €, 8,99 €, 3,99 €
10.extractionRationale: Five retail prices were found on the bike-discount.de page for different Clik Valve conversion kits and accessories: 11,99 €, 3,79 €, 9,99 €, 8,99 €, and 3,99 €. The median of these five prices is 8,99 € (the middle value when sorted: 3,79 | 3,99 | 8,99 | 9,99 | 11,99).

27.evidenceText: Three distinct Clik valve product URLs identified: p1859950.html (80mm), p1859952.html (Umrüstkit), p1859948.html (40mm). Source 4 is a category page, Source 5 is a tube product, not Clik valve listings.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs with product IDs (p-numbers) for Clik valve products only. Excluded category/filter page (f.serie) and non-Clik products (Schlauch/tube). Each distinct p-number URL = 1 product listing.

56.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve kaufen - Top Auswahl
56.evidenceText: Four distinct Schwalbe inner tube models identified: No. 17 (28"/700C 28-47/622-635), Nr. 12 (26" 30/47-559/597 40mm), Nr. 7 (20" 40/62-406 40mm), No. 19 (27.5/28/29" 40-62/622-). Each has unique size designation and model number with Clik Valve (SCV) interface.
56.extractionRationale: Counted only distinct inner tube models with Clik Valve interface from the five sources. No. 17, Nr. 12, Nr. 7, and No. 19 are four separate tube models/SKUs with different sizes and ETRTO specifications. Excluded Source 4's valve accessory kit as it is not an inner tube. Each model represents a unique product SKU based on tube size or model designation.

61.sourceTitle: Aluminum at a 4-Year High as Hormuz Disruption Reprices the Supply Chain | Investing.com
61.evidenceText: Three-month LME aluminum futures rose 1.7% to $3,571 per metric ton in mid-morning European trading on April 13, their highest level since March 2022.
61.extractionRationale: The price $3,571 USD/t is directly stated in all three sources as the current LME 3-month aluminum spot price as of April 13. This is already expressed in USD per metric ton, the requested unit.
